verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents recurring scheduled tasks using cron syntax, with schedules that sync on dev or deploy. The dashboard can create, activate, disable, edit and delete schedules, which gives pause/resume without a redeploy, and a user reports scheduled tasks 'just work.' Overlap control is only approximated by queue concurrencyLimit rather than an explicit overlap policy, and no evidence shows a view of upcoming runs. missing for 10: explicit overlap policy (skip/buffer/cancel), visibility into upcoming/next scheduled runs.
